title: NASA satellites revealed 14 active water areas beneath Antarctica; one lake drained 2 cubic km in 3 years
summary_full: Scientists discovered active subglacial lakes beneath Antarctica's ice sheet. NASA satellite data revealed ice surface changes indicating water movement. These hidden lakes were found to fill and drain over short periods. This dynamic water system influences ice stream speeds and mass balance. The findings showed a hidden, active world beneath the frozen continent.
